6778.title: Thread attachment size validation and upstream error messages
6778.rootCauseOneLine: The thread upload loop sends oversized files without checking the shared limit, and generic HTTP 413 errors have no size-specific fallback.
6778.proposedFix: Check the shared 35 MiB limit before each thread attachment upload; provide file size and limit, preserve useful server messages, and explain generic upstream 413 responses without discarding draft contents.
6778.caveats: Composer-boundary reproduction only. No live connect relay or original video was exercised. Main uses 35 MiB for every file type, not the older limits described in the issue. Actual remote rejection origin and typed-draft preservation were not dynamically verified.
